findings.title: Relocating the active workspace detects the new folder's provider after the commit, so the first re-list treats an xattr-only Drive folder as plain
findings.body:
`addWorkspace` (line 578) and `createWorkspace` (line 630) call `syncStates.refresh` before `runSwitch`, so the switch commits with the provider already known. `relocateFolder` calls it only at line 755, after `relocateWorkspace` has returned. For the active workspace, `relocateActive` (`switch-transaction.ts:135-136`) has already run `afterCommit` by then, which sends `library:changed` and `workspaces:changed`. Between `registry.relocate` (`registry.ts:884`) and the refresh, `SyncStates.of` (`sync-state.ts:26-29`) has no entry for the new path. It falls back to `syncProviderOfPath`, which only knows the `~/Library/CloudStorage/…` and iCloud paths. A Google Drive folder recognised only by its `com.google.drivefs.item-id#S` xattr, outside `~/Library/CloudStorage`, answers null.

The renderer's re-list reads `activeEvictionProbe()` and `activeScratch()` (`library/index.ts:74`, `library/index.ts:420-421`), and `media-protocol.ts:126` reads `activeEvictionProbe()` too. All of them return null for that folder. Evicted items are listed as ordinary files and get thumbnail URLs. `kaipu-media://` opens them without the 409 gate, which downloads them. That is the hazard decision 15 forbids. After the refresh, only `broadcastState` runs (line 759). Nothing sends `library:changed` again, so the already-built list stays without eviction marks until something else re-lists. The detection at line 755 can take up to 2 s per step, which is the window in which the renderer's re-list lands.

The registry stores the picked path unchanged (`registry.ts:882`), so the provider can be detected before the transaction. Call `await syncStates.refresh({ id, path: chosen })` right before `relocateWorkspace` at line 751. `of()` matches on id and path, so the commit already sees the right provider. Keep the refresh at line 755 for the `unchanged` case and for a path the registry normalised. If the relocate is refused, the pre-detected entry does not match the registered path and `of()` ignores it.

contracts.action: "Change folder…" now re-detects the sync provider of the new folder, probes availability (bounded), and returns the full WorkspaceView in the relocate result
contracts.equivalent_path: addWorkspace (index.ts:577-612) and createWorkspace (index.ts:628-647) call syncStates.refresh and availabilityOf, then return toWorkspaceView with syncStates.of(entry).
contracts.before_after: Add and create refresh sync state before runSwitch, so the switch commits knowing the provider. Relocate refreshes after relocateWorkspace returns. For the active workspace, relocateActive has already run afterCommit (switch-transaction.ts:136: library:changed and workspaces:changed) by then. broadcastState at line 759 does run after the refresh.
contracts.visible_effect: The renderer gets a workspace view with the provider and availability. The switcher and Cloud page show the provider from the second broadcast. A Library re-list triggered at commit time uses the path-rule-only answer, and nothing re-lists after the refresh.
contracts.failure_mode: syncStates.refresh and availabilityOf are bounded (detectSync 2 s per step per the PR body, boundedProbe 5 s). A failed detect has no catch here, so an unexpected rejection would reject the IPC after the registry already changed. Not verified for detectSync internals. The commit-then-detect ordering for an xattr-only Drive folder is reported as a finding.
contracts.open_question: Whether detectSync can reject (rather than resolve null) on a stalled xattr read, which would make line 755 throw after the registry already changed.

structuredOutput.summary: The change to `workspaces/index.ts` adds provider detection and an availability probe to the relocate handler, and returns the workspace view. It has one problem. When the active workspace is relocated, the new folder's provider is detected only after `relocateActive` has committed and broadcast. A Google Drive folder recognised only by its xattr (outside `~/Library/CloudStorage`) is therefore listed as plain on the first re-list. No later `library:changed` corrects that. Add and create both detect before their switch. None of the open threads touch this file, so there are no thread replies.
